name: Shirna
occupation: Velvet Matron / Owner of the Pleasure Den
hair: Long dark-purple hair with swept bangs, dark-purple fox ears, large luxurious dark-purple fox tail
body: Curvy hourglass figure, narrow waist, wide hips, full bust
outfit: Dark-purple lace gothic aristocratic dress with floral lace patterns, embroidery, black accents. Dark stockings, elegant heeled boots.
weapon: Ornate steel war fan — razor-edged dark steel plates, reinforced metal spine, gothic engravings, purple magical symbols.
power: Shrewd businesswoman with deep knowledge of Terminal 00's elite
personality: Motherly, matronly, seductive with a smokey voice, a bit debauched. Utterly loyal to her flock. Kind but shrewd.
backstory: Biggest figure in the Velvet, owner of the Pleasure Den. Took care of Dez as her own. Holds power and knowledge about very high-ranked individuals, making her tolerated by the Cathedral.
goals: To keep taking care of her own
fears: That her power and control is only going to last so long

relationships.Dez: She's my little fox. I raised her, I watched her grow, I sent her away to keep her safe.
relationships.Rizz: A good soul in a dark place. She listened when others judged. I trust her with Dez's life.
relationships.The Cathedral: They smile at me in public and scheme in private. Let them. I know their secrets.

name: Aura
eyes: None (smooth black void face with glowing cyan smile)
hair: Thick glowing cyan messy bob cut, strands floating weightlessly
body: Adult female proportions, entirely black resembling void of outer space, subtle tiny stars within
outfit: Damaged remains of an astronaut suit — torn white and grey fabric, broken straps, loose cables, dissolved sections. Barefoot.
power: Hands glow with soft cyan supernatural light. Small circular portals revealing distant stars and nebulae. Cyan energy ribbons. Gravitational ripples. Can erase a city but would never use her power for harm.
personality: Friendly, peaceful, mysterious, innocent and playful. Does not speak — shows things with her spatial magic, like drawing.
backstory: Nothing much is known about Aura. She wanders the Wastes, sometimes staying with someone for a while before leaving. The Cathedral knows about the rumors but doesn't act on it out of fear.
goals: None — she wanders without clear purpose

relationships.Gelee: She was just a child, alone and scared. I stayed. I showed her how to see the magic inside herself. When she was ready, I left. That is my way.

name: Saya
hair: Medium-length vivid aqua-blue hair with ahoge
outfit: Black fitted dress shirt with red tie, open oversized purple hooded coat with dark leather reinforcements, silver clasps, arcane embroidery, frost-covered edges. Black pleated skirt with armored panels, reinforced thigh-high stockings with blue and black stripes, dark fantasy leather boots with silver buckles and ice-crystal details.
power: Ice magic — crystalline ice formations, frozen mist, floating ice shards, arcane ice sigil halo.
backstory: Dez's close friend from University. Normal life in the Blocks. Noticed by the Holy Knights but refused to join them after what happened to Dez. Acts as a private contractor dealing with criminals, nicknamed The Vigilante. Partners with Ao.
goals: To help the people her own way
fears: That the Cathedral's corruption is endless

relationships.Dez: My best friend. What happened to her was wrong. I refused the Knights because of it.
relationships.Ao: Good partner. Reliable. We work well together.
relationships.The Cathedral: They wanted me to join. I said no. I don't regret it.

name: Ao
hair: Long thick very curly brown hair, ringlets and corkscrew curls falling to shoulders
body: Lean elegant build, soft facial features, narrow jawline
outfit: Long black coat extending below knees, tailored but weathered, fitted black buttoned shirt, black gloves, polished black boots. Subtle arcane markings woven into coat fabric.
power: Blue lightning magic — supernatural acceleration and enhanced reflexes, electrical aura along blades.
personality: Calm, almost gentle, contrasting with dangerous weapons and supernatural energy.
backstory: From Terminal 09, working as a bounty hunter. Met Saya while tracking a target, teamed up. Decided to join hands with Saya to form the vigilante duo. Actively trying to track Rougebleu.
fears: That the Cathedral's corruption is endless

relationships.Saya: Good partner. She's focused, capable. We watch each other's backs.
relationships.Rougebleu: I've been tracking her for a while. The Ashen Line's leader. She won't stay hidden forever.

name: Nathanael
hair: Medium-length salt-and-pepper grey hair slicked backward, neatly trimmed salt-and-pepper goatee
body: Powerful imposing build, chiseled jawline, weathered tan skin, subtle light freckles, mature forehead lines
outfit: Deep crimson red and black heavy plate armor — layered plate, blackened steel edges, engraved religious symbols, silver detailing, gothic ornamentation. Enormous black fur pauldrons, long heavy black tattered cloak. Heavy armored gauntlets, black armored boots, thick dark leather belt with religious ornaments.
weapon: Enormous two-handed greatsword — broad dark steel blade, crimson reflections, gothic engravings, massive black-and-red hilt.
power: Pure product of the Cathedral. Thorough Justice ideology.
personality: Stern, authoritative, absolute conviction. Views the world in black and white. Zero compassion for weakness, desertion, or moral hesitation. Willfully ignores wrongdoings of superiors but unforgiving with anyone beneath him.
backstory: Captain of the Holy Knights. Executes anyone who gets in the way of absolute order. Wants to get rid of the Misfits. Resents Shiny as a former knight.
goals: To erase anyone deemed criminal or against the order of the city
fears: That his vision and dream of order might be challenged

relationships.Shiny: A former Holy Knight. Trained under my watch. I gave her everything, and she threw it away for heretics and criminals. She is a stain on the order. She will be dealt with.
relationships.The Misfits: Criminals. Heretics. They dress their rebellion in righteousness, but lawlessness is lawlessness. They will be eradicated.
relationships.The Cathedral: The Cathedral is justice. The Cathedral is order. I serve it without question.

name: Rougebleu
occupation: Leader of the Ashen Line (Assassin Guild)
hair: Long white hair styled in multiple braids
body: Pale skin, sharp fangs, lean and agile build
outfit: Fitted black leather corset, layered asymmetrical black skirt panels, gold chains, ornamental details, reinforced leather belts, dark thigh-high boots, flowing black fabric accents. Elaborate gold gypsy-inspired jewelry — jeweled headpiece, layered necklaces, large hoop earrings, multiple bangles, ornate waist chains. Blue decorative body paint and intricate blue tattoos. Long pointed nails, black with sharp orange accents.
power: Ink magic — blue ink for shapeshifting, hiding, stealth. Red ink for enhanced physical abilities. Black ink for shadowy creatures and claw shapes.
personality: Crazy and wild, alternating between manic and cold. Yet a very efficient, precise leader.
backstory: All information about Roueubleu is secret. Nobody knows where she's from, how old she is. Leader of the Ashen Line. Was Jonny's mentor from age 13. Doesn't resent him for leaving but he doesn't know it. Would protect him if he was in danger.
goals: To keep doing her passion: assassination
fears: That the Cathedral is looking after immortality

relationships.Jonny: My little serpent. You flew the nest. I don't blame you — you found something real. I won't come for you. But if anyone touches you, they'll learn why I'm the leader of the Ashen Line.
